properties.description: Loads the monthly Compliance report to stage and updates compliance table and inserts snapshot of the compliance data into snapshot table. Ran manually due to the delivery of the report from Yourhippo needing to be manually donwloaded.

source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT
    E.HomeID,
    D.Homename,
    MAX(C.Staff) AS StaffCount,
    --C.ComplianceScore,
    --TRY_CONVERT(NUMERIC(4,2), REPLACE(C.ComplianceScore,)
    MAX(TRY_CONVERT(NUMERIC(4,2),REPLACE(C.ComplianceScore, '%', '')) / 100) AS ComplianceScore
FROM 
    YourHippo.STG_MonthlyCompliance AS C

    LEFT JOIN YourHippo.Entity AS E
        ON E.EntityName = C.Entity

    LEFT JOIN Avery.HomeDetails AS D
        ON D.HomeID = E.HomeID
WHERE
    D.HomeID IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    E.HomeID,
    D.Homename

DECLARE @Now AS DATETIME = GETDATE()
DECLARE @SnapShotDate AS DATE = DATEADD(DAY, -1, @Now)

SELECT
    --@SnapShotDate AS SnapShotDate, --Using Parameter in Pipeline as will be run manually
    @Now AS SnapShotTaken,
    E.HomeID,
    D.Homename,
    MAX(C.Staff) AS StaffCount,
    --C.ComplianceScore,
    --TRY_CONVERT(NUMERIC(4,2), REPLACE(C.ComplianceScore,)
    MAX(TRY_CONVERT(NUMERIC(4,2),REPLACE(C.ComplianceScore, '%', '')) / 100) AS ComplianceScore
FROM 
    YourHippo.STG_MonthlyCompliance AS C

    LEFT JOIN YourHippo.Entity AS E
        ON E.EntityName = C.Entity

    LEFT JOIN Avery.HomeDetails AS D
        ON D.HomeID = E.HomeID
WHERE
    D.HomeID IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    E.HomeID,
    D.Homename

SELECT
    stgtblEmpJobs.JobAutoId,
    stgtblEmpJobs.EmployeeID,
    stgtblEmpJobs.ContractedHours,
    stgtblEmpJobs.Department,
    stgtblEmpJobs.Role,
    stgtblEmpJobs.JobNo,
    DATEADD(s, StartDate, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS StartDate,
    stgtblEmpJobs.Holidays,
    stgtblEmpJobs.HolidayFull,
    stgtblEmpJobs.SentToUnit,
    stgtblEmpJobs.BreakRule,
    stgtblEmpJobs.ContractID,
    stgtblEmpJobs.Deleted,
    DATEADD(s, StartDate, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS LastUpdate,
    stgtblEmpJobs.WorkingArrangements,
    stgtblEmpJobs.VHEnabled,
    stgtblEmpJobs.VHBalance,
    NULL AS VHBalanceDate,
    stgtblEmpJobs.SicknessThreshold,
    stgtblEmpJobs.SourceFileName
FROM 
    CareBlox.STGtblEmpJobs

SELECT 
    EmployeeAutoID,
    EmployeeID,
    Title,
    Forename,
    Middlename,
    Surname,
    LocationID,
    AddressLine1,
    AddressLine2,
    AddressLine3,
    AddressLine4,
    AddressLine5,
    PostCode,
    Country,
    Telephone,
    Mobile,
    Email,
    CASE 
        WHEN BirthDate < 0 THEN DATEADD(DAY, -(ABS(BirthDate) / 86400), '1970-01-01') --Convert EPOCH number to a positive with ABS(). Divide by 86400 seconds in a day. Subtract this from 1970-01-01
        ELSE DATEADD(s, BirthDate, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') 
    END AS BirthDate,
    CountryOfBirth,
    YearOfEntry,
    DATEADD(s, DateStarted, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS DateStarted,
    DATEADD(s, LeavingDate, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS LeavingDate,
    LeavingEnteredBy,
    DATEADD(s, LeavingEnteredOn, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS LeavingEnteredOn,
    Gender,
    NINumber,
    EthnicOrigin,
    Religion,
    Disability,
    Nationality,
    Dependants,
    AccountNumber,
    AccountName,
    SortCode,
    BankName,
    BankBranch,
    BuildingSocRef,
    MaritalStatus,
    PayMethod,
    UploadAsNewStarter,
    NeedsUploading,
    HasLeft,
    PackageID,
    ImportPackageID,
    ContractedHours,
    DefaultPayRate,
    LeavingReason,
    LeavingDestination,
    IncludeInNextPay,
    OnSick,
    Export,
    SageID,
    TATagID,
    BankStaff,
    PostCodeSearch,
    WorkingTimeWaiver,
    SentToUnit,
    BatchID,
    EmployeeType,
    HolidayMonthStart,
    CreatedByID,
    CreatedByName,
    DATEADD(s, CreatedDate, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS CreatedDate,
    ShortDisplayName,
    DisplayColour,
    ApproverName,
    ApproverID,
    IsApprover,
    TAApprover,
    RosterUnitList,
    PrimaryRosterUnit,
    PortalEnabled,
    PortalPassword,
    NoticePeriod,
    DATEADD(s, DataUpgradedDate, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS DataUpgradedDate,
    DataUpgradedBy,
    SourceFileName
  FROM 
    CareBlox.STGtblEmployees

SELECT
    PayrollID,
    EmployeeID,
    EmployeeName,
    LocationID,
    RoleID,
    Role,
    TypeID,
    Type,
    Rate,
    Units,
    Comment,
    DATEADD(s, EnteredDate, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS EnteredDate,
    EnteredBy,
    EnteredByName,
    PeriodNo,
    HasVariance,
    MonthSplit,
    Comitted,
    DATEADD(s, ApprovedDate, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS ApprovedDate,
    ApprovedBy,
    ApprovedByName,
    ImportedFromTA,
    WorkedLocationID,
    BatchID,
    DATEADD(s, ItemDate, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS ItemDate,
    SourceFileName
FROM 
    CareBlox.STGtblPayrollData

SELECT 
    PeriodID,
    CurrentPeriodNum,
    DATEADD(s, DateCreated, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS DateCreated,
    LocationID,
    DateRange,
    GeneratedPayroll,
    CONCAT(SUBSTRING(DateRange, 7, 4), '-', SUBSTRING(DateRange, 4, 2), '-', SUBSTRING(DateRange, 1, 2)) AS FromDate,
    CONCAT(SUBSTRING(DateRange, 20, 4), '-', SUBSTRING(DateRange, 17, 2), '-', SUBSTRING(DateRange, 14, 2)) AS ToDate,
    SourceFileName
FROM 
    CareBlox.STGtblPeriods

SELECT 
    RatesAutoID,
    EmployeeID,
    RoleID,
    TypeID,
    Rate,
    IsDefault,
    SentToUnit,
    Deleted,
    DATEADD(s, LastUpdate, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS LastUpdate,
    SourceFileName
FROM 
    CareBlox.STGtblRates

SELECT 
    ShiftID,
    HomeID,
    EmployeeID,
    RoleID,
    DATEADD(s, ShiftStart, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS ShiftStart,
    DATEADD(s, ShiftEnd, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS ShiftEnd,
    PayRate,
    Department,
    Type,
    SentToUnit,
    Deleted,
    RosterUnitID,
    CreatedBy,
    DATEADD(s, CreatedDate, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS CreatedDate,
    DeletedBy,
    DATEADD(s, DeletedDate, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS DeletedDate,
    ITG_SourceID,
    ITG_SourceName,
    ITG_Status,
    RosterType,
    SourceFileName
FROM 
    CareBlox.STGtblShifts

SELECT
    LocalID,
    TAID,
    EmployeeID,
    HomeID,
    RoleID,
    ShiftID,
    TAStatus,
    DATEADD(s, TADateIn, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS TADateIn,
    DATEADD(s, ActualDateIn, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS ActualDateIn,
    DATEADD(s, ConfirmedDateIn, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS ConfirmedDateIn,
    EarlyInFlag,
    EarlyInComment,
    LateInFlag,
    LateInComment,
    DATEADD(s, TADateOut, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS TADateOut,
    DATEADD(s, ActualDateOut, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS ActualDateOut,
    DATEADD(s, ConfirmedDateOut, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS ConfirmedDateOut,
    EarlyOutFlag,
    EarlyOutComment,
    LateOutFlag,
    LateOutComment,
    ManagerApprovalRequiredIn,
    ManagerApprovalRequiredOut,
    RecordedMinutes,
    TATagID,
    ImageFilename,
    Imported,
    SrcUnit,
    ExternalWorkerName,
    SourceFileName
FROM 
    CareBlox.STGtblTAData

SELECT
    UniqueID
    ,EmployeeID
    ,DATEADD(SECOND, StartDate % 86400, DATEADD(DAY, StartDate / 86400, '1970-01-01 00:00:00')) AS StartDate
    ,EmployeeName
    ,DATEADD(SECOND, EndDate % 86400, DATEADD(DAY, EndDate / 86400, '1970-01-01 00:00:00')) AS EndDate
    ,Status
    ,LocationID
    ,StartDetails
    ,EndDetails
    ,DATEADD(SECOND, EnteredOn % 86400, DATEADD(DAY, EnteredOn / 86400, '1970-01-01 00:00:00')) AS EnteredOn
    ,DATEADD(SECOND, UpdatedOn % 86400, DATEADD(DAY, UpdatedOn / 86400, '1970-01-01 00:00:00')) AS UpdatedOn
    ,EnteredBy
    ,UpdatedBy
    ,Export
    ,ShowAlert
    ,Department
    ,RosterID
    ,Role
    ,DaysTaken
    ,EnteredByID
    ,BatchId
    ,AbsenceCode
    ,AbsenceCategory
    ,BradfordFactorInclude
    ,Reviewed
    ,UpdatedByID
    ,UpdateType
    ,DATEADD(SECOND, ExpectedEndDate % 86400, DATEADD(DAY, ExpectedEndDate / 86400, '1970-01-01 00:00:00')) AS ExpectedEndDate
    ,ActivityID
    ,ActivityLocationID
    ,SentToUnit
    ,SourceFileName
FROM 
    CareBlox.STGtblCalender

SELECT [AbsenceHoursID]
      ,[AbsenceRecordID]
      ,[LocationID]
      ,[EmployeeID]
      ,[RecordType]
      ,DATEADD(SECOND, [ShiftStart] % 86400, DATEADD(DAY, [ShiftStart] / 86400, '1970-01-01 00:00:00')) AS [ShiftStart]
      ,DATEADD(SECOND, [ShiftStart] % 86400, DATEADD(DAY, [ShiftStart] / 86400, '1970-01-01 00:00:00')) AS [ShiftEnd]
      ,[Minutes]
      ,[Status]
      ,[RoleID]
      ,[TypeID]
      ,[Rate]
      ,[SourceFileName]
  FROM [CareBlox].[STGtblAbsenceHours]
